messages:
leo: Starting the 5% staged rollout for model v2.3.1 to us-east and eu-west now. Keeping eu-west pinned until we confirm kv-cache stability.
sarah: thx. I'll watch latency and error rate dashboards (console + datadog).
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/v2.3.1 -> routing: 5% (global). Canary nodes: 3. Change window: 03:00-05:00 UTC.
ajay: seeing a small uptick in embedding latency 90p in eu-west already, +60ms. Not sure if it's noise.
irina: @ajay can you paste the query histogram? also are these new quantized kernels?
ajay: pasted: ```eu-west embedding p90: baseline 120ms -> now 185ms; error rate unchanged. Model variant: v2.3.1-q8```. No infra alerts yet.
sarah: can we hold at 5% for eu-west? other regions look fine.
leo: hold eu-west. route only us-east for now. Pin eu-west to v2.2.9. Ops, can you apply region pin? @ops
ops: on it, applying pin: `route(eu-west)->v2.2.9`. Confirming traffic shift back.
deploy-bot: Traffic routing update applied. eu-west traffic: 100% -> v2.2.9. Global rollout remains 5% in us-east.
ajay: after the pin, eu-west p90 returned to baseline. us-east still shows slight backend latency +15ms on generation steps (within SLO).
sarah: propose we pause further percent increases until we get a perf trace on v2.3.1 kv cache behavior. I can run a focused smoke set and some perf profiles.
leo: agree. no increase until we have regression triage. Can we also mark this in release notes: partial EU pin due to perf regression?
irina: I'll open a quick issue with traces + repro steps and tag infra + runtime.
ops: creating incident channel #inc-3861234567 and attaching current logs.
leo: final: paused global rollout. ops pinned eu-west, rollback not required (we routed back). We'll reconvene in 30m after triage. :thumbsup:
